summary: They move to impeach you: {the body} opens proceedings to impeach or censure you over {the charge}.
realLife: One life: The House impeached him in 2019 with no votes from his own party, and the Senate acquitted him. Impeached again in 2021, he was acquitted 57 to 43 with seven Republicans voting to convict. Another: In 2009 a South Carolina House committee voted against impeaching him and for censure instead, which the full House passed.
